sections.A: Biceps ke do sar hain. Lamba sar kandhe ke aage ek naali mein se guzarta hai. Is tendon ka dard ya rupture (phatna) is chapter mein hai.
sections.B: Kandhe ke aage dard jo baazu ke aage tak ja sakta hai, uthane, kheenchne aur haath upar karne se barhta hai.
sections.C: Dard kahan hai (kandha ya kohni), aur kya achanak 'pop' ki aawaz ke saath baazu mein ubhar aaya.
sections.D: Ubhar, neel aur sukhne ko dekhein, aur biceps ki naali ko dabayein.
sections.E: Biceps tests ki accuracy kam hai. Inhein dabane aur baaqi exam ke saath milayein.
sections.F: Rotator cuff ka dard aur subscapularis tear isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Seene ka dard ya paseena (dil), ya kohni par achanak pop aur kamzor supination (distal rupture): foran refer, kyunki is ki surgery jaldi hoti hai.
sections.H: Achanak pop aur ubhar ho to rupture ka shak. Kohni wala (distal) rupture urgent hai. Warna aage ka dard aur naali par dard: biceps tendinopathy.
sections.I: Ird gird ki muscles par soft tissue kaam aur thoracic mobilisation.
sections.J: Pehle isometric elbow flexion, phir aahista bhaari curls aur dheere dheere overhead aur functional load.
sections.K: Barf, garmi aur TENS optional. Injection doctor ka faisla hai.
sections.L: Rupture check karein, samjhayein, dard wala kheenchna kam karein, phir tendon par dheere dheere load barhayein.
sections.M: Dard, naali par dard, Speed aur Yergason, taaqat aur kaam dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 58 saal ke carpenter ko uthane par kandhe ke aage dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education aur dheere dheere barhta tendon load.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
